summary: Frontend-only test of the trip-type flag, Trip Planning to-dos, the Provisions bubble and hop, Single hand in the crew window, and the Model Vessel guide/training overlap. Run at 390x844 as test-admin-1 on boat main (TODO) and the Model Vessel, plus test-user-pro/main. Every requested check passed. Trip type: a one-leg plan with no draft shows the return-trip checkbox (ticked). A Quick Draft plan that ends away from START shows passage-flag 'PASSAGE'. A plan back at START on the same date shows day-trip-flag 'DAY TRIP'. The same route finishing 2 days later shows return-trip-flag 'RETURN TRIP'. one-way-trip-flag is never rendered. To-dos: trip-todos (1) Crew prep and invite, 2) Provisioning) shows under trip-next-step when a date is set and is not rendered without one. trip-todo-crew puts mbp-glow on route-crew/prep/roles-btn for about 5s (on at 4.4s, off at 5.9s). trip-todo-provisions does the same for route-provisions-btn only. Provisions: route-provisions-btn comes right after Roles in the sky tone and opens Provisions. provisions-hop-route-btn 'Trip Planning' goes back. Ticking an item shows trip-todo-provisions-done and unticking removes it. Crew window: crew-trip-name shows 'TEST_Type Trip'. crew-single-hand sits above crew-register-open-btn. Ticking it shows trip-todo-crew-done and '(S)', unticking removes both, and the value survives a reload. With a TEST_ invite out, crew-single-hand is hidden and crew-done shows without (S). Cancelling the invite in the window brings the checkbox back and shows (S) at once (mbp:crew-info). Model Vessel: while the Trip Planning guide runs, no training window shows and the strip shows training-show-btn. Picking Basic Introduction from Help ends the guide and shows its window. After Skip guide the window stays closed until Show steps is pressed. Regression: departure today gives a yellow Leave bubble, '(today)' and the 'Next step...' link, and the link switches to Leaving Dock. scrollWidth is 390 everywhere. Two bugs found: one fixed (false Discard prompt), one reported (Show steps during the guide).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: Single hand saves as soon as you tick it, but the dialog's unsaved-changes guard treated it as a pending edit. Closing the crew window after ticking it brought up a false 'Discard your changes?' prompt. Fix: added data-autosave to the crew-single-hand label. Re-verified: no prompt and the value persists.

ui_bugs.component: TrainingMode Show steps while Trip Planning guide runs
ui_bugs.issue: During the guide, tapping training-show-btn sets shut=false, but show = !paused && !shut..., so nothing opens and the Show steps button disappears for the rest of the guide (a dead tap). shut is now false, so when the guide ends (paused flips to false) the training window pops up by itself, which breaks 'after the guide it stays closed'. Fix: hide or disable Show steps while paused, or make it end the guide (tg.skip()) and then open the wizard.

issues: '(S)' after the green tick is underlined. The parent button's underline carries on to it, and no-underline on the child span can't remove it. Move (S) outside the underlined text or use decoration-transparent on the parent part.
At 390px the Provisions bubble wraps to a second row under Crew/Prep/Roles. It is still in order after Roles, but not visually to the right of it.

action_items: TrainingMode: stop Show steps from becoming a dead tap during the Trip Planning guide, and stop the wizard auto-opening when the guide ends after that tap

Consider the trip flag when the dates are missing. A loop with no depart_at, or with Leg 2 times not yet entered, shows 'Return Trip' because sameDay is false. It may be better to show Day Trip or nothing until the dates exist.
critical_code_review_comments: NavigatorAsk: endAt uses last leg finish_at || depart_at. If both are empty (a typical new 2-leg loop before times are typed), the plan is labelled Return Trip by default.

TripTodos only renders when the boat has a Leaving Dock list (onLeaving), because it sits inside the trip-next-step block. Boats without that list (e.g. test-user-pro/main) never get the to-dos. This matches the spec ('under the link') but is worth knowing.
TripTodos fetches /boats/{id}/crew on every mount (each Trip Planning visit). It is cheap, but it could reuse the crew count from boat state.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested checks pass; 1 bug fixed, 1 minor bug reported)
